tracking.trackingName: COM_NCB Highlight (Western Carolina Catamounts vs. Samford Bulldogs: Game Highlights) 2025/02/22 ESHEET

article.story: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. -- — Trey Fort had 24 points in Samford's 93-72 victory over Western Carolina on Saturday. Fort had five rebounds and five steals for the Bulldogs (21-8, 11-5 Southern Conference). Rylan Jones scored 16 points while going 6 of 12 (4 for 10 from 3-point range) and added five rebounds and seven assists. Jaden Brownell went 5 of 10 from the field (1 for 5 from 3-point range) to finish with 11 points. The Catamounts (8-19, 4-12) were led by Marcus Kell, who recorded 19 points and three blocks. Chevalier Emery added 15 points and four assists for Western Carolina.
